title: Reflection-Word Frequency
dataSources: Prayer sessions (`prayer:session`), scripture readings (`scripture:reading`), fasting logs (`fasting:log`), gratitude entries (`gratitude:entry`), retreats (`retreat:event`).
app: Spiritual-practice and mindfulness logs — prayer / meditation timers, scripture-reading plans (YouVersion), fasting and gratitude journals, and retreat calendars — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=gratitude:entry
| rex field=text max_match=0 "(?<word>\w{4,})"
| stats count by word
| sort - count
| head 20
description: Finds the words you use most often in your reflections and gratitude notes, revealing what is on your heart.
value: Recurring words are a quiet mirror of your season of life and what you are wrestling with or thankful for.
implementation: Ingest reflection text into `index=personal`; count the most frequent meaningful words.
visualization: Word list or cloud of most-used reflection words.

references.title: Greater Good Science Center — gratitude research

grandmaExplanation: It finds the words you write most in your reflections, quietly showing what is on your mind and heart.
